question: The rivers Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet to form river:
solution:
The correct answer is **Ganga**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhagirathi and Alaknanda** are the two main tributaries that merge to form the river Ganga.
 
• The confluence of these rivers occurs at a place called **Devprayag** in Uttarakhand, India.
 
• The Ganga is considered one of the most sacred rivers in India and holds significant religious importance.
